units.source_text: “当然，我嘛，也不是不知道这清沙的活儿，对村子是多么重要……

en.t: Of course, I am not saying I do not understand how important this sand-clearing work is to the village...

units.source_text: 不管怎么说，是个生计问题嘛……

en.t: After all, it is a matter of livelihood...

units.source_text: 很重要……我知道得很清楚……

en.t: It is very important... I understand that perfectly well...

units.source_text: 用不着这样强制，说不定我还会自觉地前来帮忙嘛……

en.t: There is no need to force me like this; I might even have come to help on my own...

units.source_text: 看到这里的实际情况，想帮一把，实在也是人之常情嘛。

en.t: Seeing what things are actually like here, it is only human to want to lend a hand.

units.source_text: 但是你们这种方法，最后会得到真正的帮助吗？

en.t: But with this way of doing things, will you really get genuine help in the end?

units.source_text: 为什么不再多考虑些其他适当的方法呢？

en.t: Why not give more thought to some other, more suitable methods?
...People, you know, ought to be in the place where they fit...

units.source_text: 没有好的立脚点，纵然有意志想来协助，也会一点点磨灭的……

en.t: Without a proper footing, even the will to help will gradually be worn away...

units.source_text: ……用不着这种危险的走钢丝，难道就没有更好的发挥我能力的途径吗？”

en.t: ...Without making me walk this dangerous tightrope, is there really no better way to put my abilities to use?"
